name: Phishing Response Policy
description: Emails matching confirmed phishing indicators with high confidence are quarantined automatically. Medium-confidence or ambiguous cases go to human review.

name: Malware Attachment Policy
description: Emails containing or linking to known malware payloads are blocked and quarantined. Attachments with executable extensions from unknown senders trigger this policy.
scope: all inbound email with attachments or download links

name: BEC / Wire-Fraud Review Policy
description: Business Email Compromise and wire-fraud attempts always require human review before any action. No automatic blocking — false positives on legitimate financial emails are costly.

name: Suspicious-Link Policy
description: Emails with suspicious or shortened URLs that cannot be definitively classified are sandboxed and held for analyst review.

name: Allowlist Policy
description: Messages from known-good domains and senders that match allowlist criteria are delivered normally.
